entities.summary: Andrew Campbell is a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenseman and current interim head coach of the Belleville Senators. He played for the Los Angeles Kings, Arizona Coyotes, and Toronto Maple Leafs of the National Hockey League (NHL). Campbell was drafted by the Kings in the third round, 74th overall of the 2008 NHL Entry Draft. He was born and raised in Caledonia, Ontario.
